goal: Make long-horizon multi-agent runs authority-safe, effect-safe, durable across upgrades and external waits, and legible under failure without weakening approvals, Seatbelt, path jail, write scope, Verifier, merge queue, capacity, or budgets.

tasks.title: TaskContract, intent authorization, and MCP schema drift
deliverables: canonical TaskContract derived only from trusted Leader plan/policy inputs
deterministic authorize(call, contract) with argument-level path/URL/argv checks
IntentViolation/IntentAmbiguous approval reasons; ambiguity escalates
mcp_tool_pins with per-(server,tool) schema/description digests and drift approval
tail/contract compaction capsule with contract_hash on context.compacted
RPC/CLI/UI: session.contract, project.mcp_pins, mcp.pin.approve, vp contract, vp mcp-pins
tests: shell argv/command mutation outside contract escalates or unknown
MCP schema/description drift requires approval; unchanged tool does not prompt
ambiguous contract escalates and never allows
contract capsule survives compaction; summarizer cannot inject constraints
tasks.acceptance: Contract checks are event-backed, narrowing-only, and replayable; no existing gate is weakened.

tasks.title: EffectReceipts and postconditions
deliverables: effect_receipts table with intent/done/failed/unknown states
begin_effect in the same transaction as tool.started; finish_effect with tool.finished
per-tool postcondition probes (file hash, git rev, run_project_task result, remote stat, HTTP status/body hash)
shell defaults to unknown unless an explicit probe is declared
effect.reconcile RPC/CLI; replay reads receipts first
coverage for git push, forge PR/MR creation, remote write, deploy, webhook
tests: crash between intent and finish becomes unknown
tasks.acceptance: External effects have local settled/unknown evidence; no remote exactly-once claim; unknown fails closed.

tasks.title: Durable external gates
deliverables: external_gates table with open/resolved/expired/cancelled states
gate.open returns a scoped one-shot token; gate.resolve is authenticated and expiry-bound
agent wait_for_gate or session.defer watch gate; resume through the normal path
local CLI/GUI/same-host CI resolution; no public webhook by default
optional loopback listener behind explicit project policy
tests: wrong token rejected; no secret in events/logs
gate wait survives daemon restart without holding a Worker slot
tasks.acceptance: External waits are durable, local-only by default, and never bypass the normal resume/gate path.

tasks.title: Version pinning and controller replay
deliverables: runtime_version, policy_hash, tool_bundle_hash, prompt_layout_version, plan_revision persisted on plans/runs
immutable policy_snapshots
resume drift warning; plan.migrate revalidates DAG/scopes/budgets/contracts
orchestration.replay diffs deterministic scheduler/task decisions
no model output replay; no budget bypass
tasks.acceptance: Plans survive releases with visible drift and approval-classified migration; replay is advisory.

tasks.title: Reliability suite and OTel projection
deliverables: pass^k, variance, flake rate
Lucky-Pass signals: commit without passing test, retry with no new evidence, edit/revert, verify-before-implement
coordination overhead and cost per solved task
optional OTel GenAI export as an event-log projection
observation-only; never a merge gate
tests: OTel span decode; no secret attributes
tasks.acceptance: Reliability is measurable without new model calls or gate changes.

tasks.title: Failure attribution and error-cascade ledger
deliverables: provenance DAG from task/input hashes/tool calls/commits/Verifier/integration
earliest unsupported claim and responsible agent/step
handoff contract: Worker result cites upstream artifact hash
false consensus: Worker+Verifier pass while integration fails
session.diagnosis / vp diagnose; advisory only
tests: upstream bad artifact is blamed before downstream failure
tasks.acceptance: Failure reports point to the earliest unsupported claim with evidence, never to a guessed culprit.

tasks.title: Bounded dynamic fan-out
deliverables: plan.fanout template + JSON item list
N <= 20 children with parent_task_id, fanout_key, disjoint write scope, join task
dedupe by key; no recursive fan-out; sibling cancel; per-task budgets
explicit approval; no automatic plan rewrite
tasks.acceptance: Fan-out is explicit, bounded, and cannot create overlapping write scopes.

tasks.title: Tool search v2 and delta browser snapshots
deliverables: BM25 + prerequisite closure set-complete retrieval
completeness_estimate and missing[]
turn-boundary event-backed schema promotion; priced tools_hash/cache epoch change
delta browser snapshots with changed/new/removed refs and text delta
snapshot generation binding; STALE_REF unchanged
tests: schema promotion event and cache epoch change
tasks.acceptance: Tool discovery returns complete call sets; schema promotion is visible and priced; snapshots are incremental.

tasks.title: MCP tasks and elicitation
deliverables: MCP tools/call task handle: working/input_required/completed
tasks/get|result|cancel|list with ttl/pollInterval
no hidden polling; map to effect receipts/gates
form elicitation routes to question inbox
URL elicitation denied by default and never auto-opened; dynamic server add stays operator-approved
tasks.acceptance: MCP async work and server input requests are durable, local-policy-bound, and auditable.

tasks.title: Code Mode run_script
deliverables: rquickjs + oxc script runner with 64 MB/CPU budget
typed bindings generated from the frozen bundle
no shell/HTTP/filesystem/process/native bindings
inner calls re-enter the dispatcher with contract/approval/budget/receipts
stdout via ToolOutputPolicy; tool.finished events
read-only spike first; write tools require per-call approvals and a declared call budget
tests: deterministic replay of script tool calls
tasks.acceptance: Scripts compose tools without ambient capabilities; every inner call is authorized and receipted.

tasks.title: A2A loopback facade
deliverables: signed/derived Agent Card
task lifecycle with input-required/auth-required
SSE + loopback only; no public push endpoint
maps external tasks to gates/contracts
tasks.acceptance: Inbound A2A is loopback-only and cannot exceed the parent contract.

tasks.title: Advisory progress ledger
deliverables: bounded progress_ledger: satisfied, in_loop, progressing, next_task, instruction, evidence
deterministic controller uses it only as evidence
max stalls/resets; no automatic replan or DAG rewrite
tasks.acceptance: Progress is legible without giving an LLM control of the scheduler.

non_goals: LLM routing of scheduler decisions or automatic DAG rewrite
public A2A/push endpoint without a partner
acceptance: cargo fmt/clippy/test, just lint, xcodebuild test
external gates one-shot, expiry-bound, no public listener by default
version drift visible and migration approval-classified
Code Mode sandbox cannot reach network/filesystem/shell

implementation.notes: C1-C5 are Contracted Execution Phase 1; C6 is Phase 2. Swift counts are combined app+helper.
